name: 奄環和弘/COMMISSIONS OPEN
description:
ご依頼等ありましたら
SKEBまたはメッセージにてお願いいたします。

works.body:
Thank you for the appeal!  I am glad you see the parts of my character that I like about her, and am curious to see what you have in mind for rendering her!

Her personality is generally cute and friendly and a little silly, though she also has a dangerous combat side to her that usually remains hidden.  You can feel free to lean into either aspect or a combination.

She should always have cybernetic arms and legs and she usually has 4 extra ones mounted on her back, but she changes her limbs out so any design or style of her limbs works if you feel like playing with your own cybernetic designs.

For clothes, she likes to look cute and fashionable and stylish, since she is trying to be an influencer.  There are several outfits she is already drawn with, but I always welcome new attempts at fashion.  Her favorite color is green and she tends to enjoy wearing hats or having a headband.

She always has an eyepatch over her right eye, though she owns many of them in different designs.  Her left eye is green and has a beauty mark under it.  She has a little bit of freckles on her face.

She often carries around sugary snacks or her phone though you can feel free to omit those details.  

I like the way you draw traditionally cute anime girls and would love to see Callie in that sort of style, so looking forward to seeing what happens!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1qmKqVYLF5DYKWsh_CKiHOsRW2zgkAhgP

Thank you for the appeal! Your art style is very cute, and I'm always happy when artists take interest in my characters. I'd love to see what you can do with my Au Ra girl; her typical expression is tsundere, like the last two images in the reference link, but pose and outfit are otherwise up to you. NSFW is on but is also your choice.

https://imgur.com/a/PRiwuhC

Hi Amawa, nice to meet you!

I'm so glad you like my Vtuber Avatar, I would love for you to create an illustration of her. I have checked out your work on various platforms and I really enjoy your art style too!

You can draw her in any way you like!

Thank you so much, I'm looking forward to it!

Hello! I'd love for you to draw my original character! Do whatever you want with them! :D by the way, the character’s name is “Light Mayer!” I love cool and sexy characters!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1MadYlWzrz3rq7mnYdgoHRFjCcMZMvY7H?usp=drive_link

Good day!

Thank you for your interest! You're the first to ask about Zera and I would love to see her drawn. 

Feel free to draw her as you like. I have included one outfit she wore before. But she can also wear a bikini or dress if you like.

Thank you for your consideration!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/16xoU67hdWt83zdmReNR62Gi4c6oi1COi?usp=sharing

Hello! I saw your appeal and wanted to reach out in regards to your appeal. I've taken a look at your portfolio and I loved what I saw! I have multiple references, but I'm absolutely happy if any of them are used.

Sakurano is a karakuri doll with a bit of a tsundere attitude, but loves helping people out and guiding them. Most of her clothing is either Traditional Japanese or Wuxia inspired but feel free to use what you'd like!

https://vgen.co/c/sakurano-takagi-

Hello 奄環和弘さん! 

Thank you so much for your appeal, I would absolutely love if you could draw Magellan for me!! 

She's a calm and level-headed kind of character with a lot of curiosity, with her self-stated mission to explore worlds and places that both humans and machines haven't yet visited. In terms of pose and composition, I trust you to make something that you enjoy! 🙇‍♂️

Thank you again for your consideration!!

References: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1_KaEeLK3LZEO3tJPp8LyylwYiA6A7eWL?usp=sharing

Hello!

Thank you so much for your kind message and for noticing Meepo Liz! I’m thrilled that you find her design striking and appreciate the idea! Your idea of highlighting her vibrant design against darker tones is fantastic—I think it would make for an amazing illustration!

I’d be delighted if you could draw Meepo Liz for use in any of my content! I dont have any special requirements for the pose or the expression. Please feel free to explore poses and expressions as you like!

If possible, I’d appreciate a PNG version with a transparent background, as the artwork may be used for things like YouTube Thumbnails, Profile Pictures or Livestream Schedules.

Thank you so much for reaching out—I’m excited to see your creative take on Meepo Liz!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ygM7FZ_G6RtjiTDdoL5bUd8-GoS9svzc?usp=sharing

Thank you so much for wishlisting my game! I looked at your portfolio and your art is very cool!
I would love for you to draw Isadora!

I really love this drawing a lot.
https://www.foriio.com/works/1387866
The pose is very dynamic, and the scarf flows very well. It's very cool. I would love Isadora to have this kind of cool energy.

I also like this drawing! The action pose is great, and I love the background effects and cool magic background!
https://www.foriio.com/works/1021719

Please draw Isadora like that!

Please include the PSD, if you can! 
Please make sure the edges of her head and body aren't cut off in the image so everything is visible!

I would like to use the art for promotional material: such as twitter, youtube, kickstarter materials/rewards, and Steam. 
And included in an art book with concept pieces that comes with the game!

Here's the reference materials for Isadora!
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1eEg2ZL3jz0JSRVTPEech8audq2U8oL4k?usp=drive_link

Thank you!
